title: Police Checker Bot
description:
A crowdsourced traffic-police checkpoint monitoring service — a Telegram bot + web app.

Users report checkpoints via the bot, other drivers see them on an interactive map or ask the bot about nearby ones. Accuracy depends on community activity.

Bot features: send a checkpoint's location, find nearby checkpoints, report history, personal profile.
Web app: map, radius radar, full history, admin panel.
